head: b4ce7ada953731d190ff7e591a4355b4f8330242
scope: PC-34 raw input -> command enqueue -> F0380 gate/dequeue -> F0365/F0366 turn/move dispatch

sourceAudit.claim: PC-34 reads IODRV keyboard input and normalizes shifted extended arrows to command-table codes K/L/M/P.
PC-34 movement keyboard table maps normalized codes to C001/C002 turn and C003..C006 move commands.
Movement-panel mouse rows map arrow boxes and viewport/right-click routes to movement/view/inventory commands.
F0361 locks the queue, searches primary then secondary keyboard tables, writes a matched command, unlocks, then replays pending click.
F0359 either records one pending click while locked or resolves primary/secondary mouse rows into a queued command.
F0380 locks, tests empty/movement-disabled state before dequeue, then unlocks/replays and dispatches turn/move commands.
F0365 sets the input wait stop flag and changes party direction through the source sensor boundary.
F0366 computes relative destination, blocks walls/doors/fakewalls/groups before side effects, discards input on block, and calls F0267 on success.
Main loop ages movement cooldowns before polling keyboard and processing exactly the queued command path.

orderChecks.claim: F0380 movement gate happens before X/Y read and queue index advance, so a gated step remains queued.
F0366 blocked route returns before successful F0267/timing route.

firestaffEvidence.claim: compat queue models PC-34 key normalization rows, mouse rows, lock/pending replay, movement gate retention, dequeue, and turn/move dispatch flags
command core consumes queue results into turn/move handling, blocks before successful movement side effects, and requests input discard/redraw at the F0366 boundary
regression covers PC-34 K/L/M/O/P/Q rows, IO2 shifted arrows, pending replay, movement-gate retention, and reserved queue slots
focused command-core regression proves PC-34 queue output reaches turn, successful movement, cooldown clearing, and blocked-step queue discard
